blurb: Introducing Pandora's Resort: under new ownership and fully transformed from Pandora's Forest. We're open and excited to showcase our improvements. The Grand Re-Opening on Memorial Day was a hit and resort updates include a the tantalizing new Red Room play space, clubhouse upgrades, renovated cabins, chalets, bathhouse, and outdoor showers. All amenities are open 24/7 for your enjoyment.
